mapper.sql: s.tenant_id, s.session_id, s.target_kind, s.target_id, s.end_user_id, s.channel, s.scope_key, s.persona_version, s.create_fingerprint, s.create_command_data, s.status, s.session_revision, s.created_epoch_second, s.created_nano, s.updated_epoch_second, s.updated_nano, owner_root.end_user_id AS root_end_user_id, stream.end_user_id AS stream_end_user_id, stream.next_sequence AS stream_next_sequence, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs execution WHERE execution.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND execution.target_kind = s.target_kind AND execution.target_id = s.target_id AND execution.session_id = s.session_id AND execution.end_user_id != s.end_user_id ) AS execution_owner_consistent

FROM public.agent_runtime_sessions s LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_owners owner_root ON owner_root.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND owner_root.target_kind = s.target_kind AND owner_root.target_id = s.target_id AND owner_root.session_id = s.session_id LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_streams stream ON stream.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND stream.target_kind = s.target_kind AND stream.target_id = s.target_id AND stream.session_id = s.session_id
mapper.select: WITH storage_clock AS (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS sampled_at) SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM sampled_at))::bigint AS epoch_second, floor((extract(epoch FROM sampled_at) - floor(extract(epoch FROM sampled_at))) * 1000000000)::integer AS nano FROM storage_clock
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_owners (tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, end_user_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{endUserId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT owner_root.tenant_id, owner_root.session_id, owner_root.target_kind, owner_root.target_id, owner_root.end_user_id, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_session_streams stream WHERE stream.tenant_id = owner_root.tenant_id AND stream.target_kind = owner_root.target_kind AND stream.target_id = owner_root.target_id AND stream.session_id = owner_root.session_id AND stream.end_user_id != owner_root.end_user_id ) AS log_stream_owner_consistent, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs execution WHERE execution.tenant_id = owner_root.tenant_id AND execution.target_kind = owner_root.target_kind AND execution.target_id = owner_root.target_id AND execution.session_id = owner_root.session_id AND execution.end_user_id != owner_root.end_user_id ) AS execution_owner_consistent FROM public.agent_runtime_session_owners owner_root WHERE owner_root.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_root.target_kind = #{targetKind} AND owner_root.target_id = #{targetId} AND owner_root.session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE OF owner_root
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_sessions ( tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, end_user_id, channel, scope_key, persona_version, create_fingerprint, create_command_data, status, session_revision, created_epoch_second, created_nano, updated_epoch_second, updated_nano) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{endUserId}, #{channel}, #{scopeKey}, #{personaVersion}, #{createFingerprint}, #{createCommandData}, #{status}, #{sessionRevision}, #{createdEpochSecond}, #{createdNano}, #{updatedEpochSecond}, #{updatedNano})

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_mutations ( tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, end_user_id, expected_status, target_status, expected_revision, causation_input_id, command_fingerprint, command_data, output_status, output_revision, output_updated_epoch_second, output_updated_nano) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{endUserId}, #{expectedStatus}, #{targetStatus}, #{expectedRevision}, #{causationInputId}, #{commandFingerprint}, #{commandData}, #{outputStatus}, #{outputRevision}, #{outputUpdatedEpochSecond}, #{outputUpdatedNano})

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_conflict_audits ( tenant_id, audit_ref, resource_id_hash, conflict_kind, current_revision, stored_fingerprint, requested_fingerprint) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{auditRef}, #{resourceIdHash}, #{conflictKind}, #{currentRevision}, #{storedFingerprint}, #{requestedFingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, audit_ref) DO NOTHING
